summary: Tested Payroll module in People Ops - Backend: 12/13 tests passed (92%). Frontend: All features verified working correctly - Navigation, Dashboard, New Payroll dialog, Period detail view, Payslip view, Payroll Config.

minor.issue: Returns 500 in pytest session but works via curl - likely session/auth handling issue in test setup

navigation_to_payroll.details: People Ops > Payroll tab navigation works correctly

payroll_dashboard.details: Shows Active Period, Payrolls this Year (1), Paid this Year ($57,526.07), Frequency (Biweekly)

payroll_history_table.details: Lists all payroll periods with columns: Period, Payment Date, Employees, Total Gross, Total Net, Status

new_payroll_dialog.details: Opens dialog with Period Type, Start Date, End Date, Payment Date, Period Name, Notes fields

create_payroll_period.details: Backend API creates period and generates entries for active employees automatically

period_detail_view.details: Shows period summary (Employees, Total Gross, Deductions, Total Net, Employer Cost) and Employee Detail table with all salary/deduction columns

deduction_calculations.details: AFP (2.87%) and ARS (3.04%) calculations verified correct: $75,000 base -> AFP $2,152.50, ARS $2,280.00

edit_entry_functionality.details: Edit icon visible in Actions column, backend API supports updating overtime, bonus, deductions

workflow_draft_to_approval.details: Submit for Approval button visible, workflow status changes: Draft -> Pending Approval

workflow_approve.details: Backend API approve endpoint works, changes status to Approved

workflow_process.details: Backend API process endpoint works, changes status to Completed

payslip_view.details: Payslip dialog shows Company, Period, Employee, Earnings, Deductions (AFP, ARS, ISR), Net Pay, Payment date, Print button

bank_file_download.details: GET /api/people-ops/payroll/periods/{id}/bank-file returns CSV with bank payment data

payroll_config.details: Shows Payment Schedule (Biweekly, Day 1: 15, Day 2: 30), AFP rates (2.87%/7.1%), ARS rates (3.04%/7.09%), SRL (1.2%), INFOTEP (1%), ISR toggle with scale, Overtime rates (1.35x/2.0x)

seed_data_used.test_periods_created: Multiple TEST_Quincena periods created during backend testing

context_for_next_testing_agent: Payroll module fully functional. Key features: 1) GET /api/people-ops/payroll/config returns deduction rates (AFP 2.87%, ARS 3.04%, etc). 2) POST /api/people-ops/payroll/periods creates period and auto-generates entries for active employees. 3) PUT /api/people-ops/payroll/entries/{id} updates overtime/bonus and recalculates net. 4) Workflow: draft -> submit -> pending_approval -> approve -> approved -> process -> completed. 5) GET /api/people-ops/payroll/entries/{id}/payslip returns full payslip data. 6) GET /api/people-ops/payroll/periods/{id}/bank-file returns CSV. Frontend components: PayrollSection.js (dashboard), PayrollPeriodView.js (detail), PayrollConfigSection.js (config).
